The ideal candidate has deep expertise in backend languages (Rust, Go, or Java), cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, AWS), and a product-first mindset. We prioritize candidates with immediate availability or short notice periods over corporate lifers with 3-month lock-ins.

Experience with Distributed Systems & Microservices at Scale
Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes and AWS
nice_to_haves: Experience in Fintech or Logistics domains
cultural_vibe: Fast-paced product engineering environment. We value shipping code over bureaucracy. We need 'Builders' who can deploy on Day 1, not 'Managers' who need 3 months to join.
